candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that zeroes the caller's balance after the transfer, so withdrawn funds remain credited in balances.
Move the balance-zeroing statement before the external call, so a reentrant caller observes a zeroed balance during withdraw.
Remove the reset of __lock_modifier0_lock after the function body, so the lock stays set forever and every subsequent withdraw reverts.
Remove the statement that sets __lock_modifier0_lock to true on entry, disabling the reentrancy guard so reentrant withdraws succeed.
